title: Grateful Dead Live at Pine Knob Music Theater on 1991-06-20
lineage: mac > Tascam 122b > Tascam HD-P2 > wav 24/48 > Adobe Audition 1.5 > Wavelab 6 with iZotope Ozone  4 > iZotope RX Advanced > wav 16/44.1 > CD Wave > Flac 16 Taped by Gregg Holtz, from front of OTS, DFC
source: Source: Audience > Nakamichi CM-300 mics with CP-4 shotgun caps > Sony TC-D5 > mac

ai_review.summary: Exceptional sound quality captures a tepid show that shines on Throwing Stones and the Drum‑Space segment.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crystal‑clear, high‑volume playback, while the performance itself is described as generally lukewarm apart from a standout bass solo by Phil on "Throwing Stones" and an inspired Drum & Space outing. Reviewers note the set list was interesting but overall the band was only average, though the superb audio makes it worth listening.

ai_rating.rationale: Multiple reviewers commend the recording as excellent; show quality is mixed with a few high points, yielding an overall rating just above four stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound described as exceptional and great; no issues reported regarding clarity or mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Set list noted as interesting but overall performance tepid; the Drum‑&‑Space segment and Phil's bass on "Throwing Stones" are the high points.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil's bass is highlighted as 'so sick' on "Throwing Stones".
band_member_comments.Drums: The Drum segment (and ensuing Space) receive strong positive remarks.
